verdict.summary: Round 5's major finding is resolved. The multi-part branch now requires exact alignment between select, gold_count, and gold_keys part names, compares each th03 part's returned first-column entity set against gold_keys[part], and retains the independent per-part row-count check. The new end-to-end mutations replace one truth_bearer and one info_bearer while preserving cardinality, drive main(), and assert a non-zero exit without a gold_count mismatch, so they exercise the real dispatch path and are not vacuous. The hermetic suite passes all 47 tests. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the reviewed diff.
